svg.aria-label: Lumen Surface Cache: direct / indirect / final lighting on proven occupancy
svg.title: Lumen Surface Cache: direct / indirect / final lighting on proven occupancy
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen Surface Cache: direct / indirect / final lighting on proven occupancy graph 0001 | scene panels = mapped-page mask, resampled panels = current-frame card-rect union | log10(1+c) per-panel p99 SCENE DIRECT (irradiance) SCENE FINAL (radiance) RESAMPLED CARD DIRECT RESAMPLED CARD INDIRECT per-panel log tone (see p99 labels) valid zero (black) unmapped/off-page (navy) nonfinite/sentinel Scene panels use the exact Lumen.PageBuffer mapped-page mask and the same 1:1 crop as the material figure (35072 mapped texels); off-page/stale atlas regions are categorical navy. Resampled panels are the 512x512 card-capture lighting atlases. They are not in the 4096 physical atlas domain: they use the exact current-frame CardPage View-rect union (31424 texels, 37 passes). The green clear value outside those rects is not data and is masked navy. Lumen.SceneDirectLighting is surface-cache direct irradiance; Lumen.SceneFinalLighting is final shaded radiance (LumenSurfaceCache.ush:49-55). Lumen.ResampledCardCapture{Direct,Indirect}Lighting are resampled card-capture lighting atlases. Each panel is displayed with log10(1+c) normalized to its own p99 (direct 16.5, resampled-direct 10, resampled-indirect 2.857, final 2.6); this is a display transform, not a cross-panel radiometric comparison.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
